save_recentered_sequences: run the CO3D dataset pipeline to save recentered sequences with optional recomputation
create_CO3DConfig: create a CO3DConfig dataclass to configure dataset arguments and batch settings for CO3Dv2
create_CO3DDataset: create a CO3DDataset instance from a CO3DConfig to parse and load CO3Dv2 data
recenter_sequences: recenter CO3D sequences by computing and saving recentered camera poses and point clouds
run_save_recentered_cli: run save_recentered_sequences as a CLI tool via tyro to process CO3Dv2 datasets
